execution_environment_note: The package brief named DigitalOcean as the primary execution environment for this bulk download/parse step. Investigated first (per explicit founder instruction) whether the isolated beatmapped-research-worker droplet could run it: found (a) inbound SSH to that droplet is deliberately closed post-bootstrap by original design (confirmed via doctl key-fingerprint comparison, not a credential-loss accident) and (b) its only sanctioned automated-access path (.github/workflows/run-beatmapped-research-proof.yml) is narrowly hardcoded to a single existing job type (berlin-browser-proof), such that adding a genuinely different bulk-file job type would require new, security-critical, remotely-untestable changes across validate-request.mjs/remote-run.sh/the workflow YAML. Running the same untested logic against the production collector droplet (1GB RAM/25GB disk, live traffic) was assessed as a real stability risk. Given both DigitalOcean paths carried real, hard-to-mitigate risk within this package's scope, the bulk download and PBF parse were run locally within this governed session instead, entirely outside any DigitalOcean droplet. This is a deliberate, disclosed deviation from the package brief's stated primary environment, made explicitly to avoid destabilising production infrastructure or shipping untested security-critical remote-execution code.
